Archie
Archie for Business

Whichever you pick renews on its own, at the same price, until you stop it: once a month, or once a year. You stop it or switch plans in Archie itself, by opening the Account page, finding Your plan, and pressing Manage plan. Change your mind within 14 days of starting and we refund what you paid in full: email questions@otianai.com and that is the whole process. Starting a plan means you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
